problems.reason: Both sentences state that the large supratemporal fenestrae are adaptations for large body size and aid in prey capture/thermoregulation, repeating the same claim.

Sentence 11 places Acresuchus in the family Alligatoridae (and subfamily Caimaninae in sentence 12), while sentence 13 claims its parent group is the genus Jacarea, which contradicts the taxonomic placement.
